title: Power On: Is Apple's HomeView Ecosystem Worth Buying Into? - Whatfinger Business & Money
text:
With the newly unveiled HomeView, Apple is finally closing the biggest gap in its ecosystem.
On this episode of the Power On podcast, Mark Gurman talks about Apple’s full lineup of devices designed to work together and what it will take to win over consumers already invested in ecosystems offered by rivals like Google and Amazon.
